name: Oruphaliru Redspirit
original_name: オルファリル・レッドスピリット
source:
An innocent, carefree girl with crimson eyes and flame-red hair. She takes to Yuuto quickly, calling him "Papa." Because she was raised as a weapon of war, she treats battle like a game and thinks nothing of killing enemy Spirits. Her halo takes the form of two spheres, whom she affectionately calls Pii-tan.
[From [url=http://www.jastusa.com/aselia/chara.html]jastusa.com[/url]]
